explanation: Pigeons and doves of both sexes make crop milk from the lining of the crop, a pouch in the throat. Flamingos and male emperor penguins make a similar food.

claims.text: Pigeons feed their newly hatched chicks crop milk, a secretion from the lining of the crop.
Sparrows, eagles and owls do not produce crop milk.
Both male and female pigeons and doves produce crop milk.
Flamingos and male emperor penguins also feed chicks a secretion similar to crop milk.
